hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom-curve AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that routes swaps entirely through Euler Finance lending vaults. The beforeSwap hook handles all token accounting by depositing input tokens into and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass Uniswap's standard concentrated-liquidity pricing. Liquidity additions and donations are intentionally blocked.
